searchQueries.title: Keywords
searchQueries.description: One search per keyword, results are merged and de-duplicated. Example: phd, stipendiat, doktorgrad, research fellow. Leave empty to list all jobs.

counties.title: County IDs
counties.description: Jobbnorge county IDs (e.g. 3 = Oslo, 11 = Rogaland). Leave empty for all Norway.

employerIds.title: Employer IDs
employerIds.description: Only jobs from these employers (e.g. 688 = NTNU).

period.title: Posted within
period.description: Only jobs published in the last week or day.

daysOld.title: Max age in days
daysOld.description: Extra filter on the publish date, applied after the search. 0 = off. Works together with 'Posted within'.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for the listing and, when available, the ad text.

includeDetails.title: Include full ad text
includeDetails.description: Fetch each ad for description, reference, contacts and apply link (one extra request per job).

startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Jobbnorge search URLs (jobbnorge.no/search?term=...) or single ad URLs (jobbnorge.no/ledige-stillinger/stilling/<id>).
